buckets.label: Humanities & Social Sciences / GE
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units. MAE engineering-major bucket that simply points to the humanities/social-sciences general-education requirement (min 24 units). At UCSD this is defined and satisfied by the student's own undergraduate college GE program (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, Seventh), not by a fixed major-specific course list, so it is covered in the college GE section. No course list applies.
